about: The vault list's rule (passation-pro briefs/design-coffre-rassurer.md §7; Alex's D6 A « Récents » and D7 A, 16/11), shared by HermesKit and Android: given `vaults` (each a `GET /v1/vault` answer, fake data) and a case's `filter` (`kind`: all | logins | cards | contacts | connectors; `for`: an agent id or null; `query`), the app draws `expect`. Written once in plain Python by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_vault_list_cases.py, which checks this file (VAULT_LIST_WRITE=1 rewrites the expected parts); bridge-rs checks the logins' `domain` is the bridge's (vault_used.rs).

rules.fold: Lower case without accents: Unicode NFD, every non-spacing mark (category Mn) dropped, then lower case, no locale. Sorting and search compare folded texts; folded keys compare by Unicode code points (no collation).
rules.kinds: login → Identifiants (logins), card and payment → Cartes (cards), address → Coordonnées (contacts), secret → Connecteurs (connectors, the accesses given through a connector's card). Any other kind is left out.
rules.for: « Pour : <agent> »: only the items whose `agents` hold that agent. Its menu (`for_menu`): the vault's `agents` that hold at least one item, by their folded name.
rules.chips: « Tout » then the four kinds, each with the number of items after « Pour » (never after the search or the chosen kind). A kind at 0 is not shown; « Tout » always is.
rules.site: A login's site: its `domain` (the bridge's, 17/11), else, from an older bridge, its origin's host without a leading « www. ».
rules.sort: By the folded name (`label`), then the folded identifier, then the id. A group of a site sorts by its folded site.
rules.groups: Two logins or more on one site (after « Pour », the kind and the search) are one group: `{group: <site>, count, rows}` (« reseau-agences.fr · 3 identifiants »), unfolded by default, its rows sorted. A site's only login is a plain row.
rules.letters: Without a search: the logins (and groups) by letter, the folded key's first character A-Z, anything else under « # », last. Letters only with the kind « all » or « logins ».
rules.recent: « Récents » (D6 A), first, without a search, with the kind « all » or « logins »: the 3 logins (after « Pour ») whose `last_used_at` is the latest, newest first, each with `used_by` (`last_used_by`, an agent id) and `used_at`. They stay in their letter too. None from a bridge without `last_used_at`.
rules.sections: After the letters: « Cartes », « Coordonnées », « Connecteurs », each sorted, each only when not empty and only with the kind « all » or its own.
rules.search: Trimmed and folded, split on spaces: every word must be found in at least one field of the item. A login: its name, its origin's host, its identifier, its login page (`login_url` without its scheme). A card: its name and `card.last4`. Contact details: their name and `contact.city`. A connector's access: its name, its origin's host, its identifier. Results: one section `results` with their count, no letters, no « Récents »: the logins (groups kept, two or more found on one site), then cards, contact details, connectors. The chips apply (a kind searches only that kind).
rules.nothing_found: A search that finds nothing: no section, `nothing_found` true (« Rien pour « … » », what the search looks at, « Ajouter un identifiant » with the name already written).
rules.looks: Each login's square (D7 A, nothing leaves the server): `initial`, its name's first character in capitals (accents kept: « É »), on the colour `color` of its site (0-6, the palette's index: the sum of the folded site's code points modulo 7; its folded name when it has no site). A group's square: its site's first character and colour. `page`: « Page : … », only when `login_url` is not the site's root: its host and path (and query); `page_grouped`, in a group: « … » and its path. Null: no line.
rules.installs: Several servers: one list per server, as today; the search runs in each.
